notes: No SM section describes this case. Every row comes from SM 2.2 rules 1, 3, 4 and 9, 2.3, 2.4 and 5.2 as docs/errata/2026-11-22-relayed-prompts.md applies them. Every credited second is level C with via_relay, and witnessed: the server uploads live.
The server has no desktop, so pairtime samples no presence and records no focus: every slot's presence is unknown.

T3 stores every message here with createdBy user. relayed_prompts counts the prompts a relay record of declared none witnessed; scheduled_prompts the task's twelve firings and the webhook's two, whose records declare cron; cross_session_prompts the laptop thread's message, whose record declares cross_session; headless_prompts the /compact and the guest's message, which have no record.

Every slot's presence is unknown, so uncredited seconds take SM 5.2's codes for such a slot: X.bucket_cap where only the 120 s cap kept the session from reading, X.agent_only or X.automated while a turn runs, else X.no_anchor.
The /compact's prompt assumes Claude Code fires UserPromptSubmit for the command T3's composer sends. That is unverified, and the case credits the same either way.
